description: Block an accountId (severing any existing friendship or pending requests and preventing future contact or profile discovery) or unblock a previously blocked accountId. Requires a registered local identity. Prefer socialwtf_remove_connection if you only want to unfriend without blocking future connection requests.

accountId.description: Target user's internal SocialWTF account ID (e.g. 'acc_01J...').

action.description: Whether to 'block' (default) or 'unblock' the target accountId.

name: socialwtf_block_user

message.description: Confirmation of block or unblock state.

success.description: True when the block state was updated.

title: Block or Unblock User Account
